module.name: Edge tab
module.responsibility: Paints a frame and its edge tab: one line with the frame's kind, name and code path on the top edge of the well
module.description: The tab's left side is the side of the frame. The frame's responsibility stays out of the picture and goes with the tab's group as the title of the picture's file.

module.name: Door button
module.responsibility: Paints a module outside the open one as a bright button, with an arrow that says where it lies in the tree from the open module
module.description: A door takes the finish of a primary action in its group's colour, or in its kind's colour when it has no group. That colour stays bright on both themes. Its icon shows its kind.

module.name: Model inspect
module.responsibility: States one module's interface or a group's boundary: entry points with what reaches them, hidden parts, callers, outgoing relationships and pass-through entry points
module.description: The command answers over the existing model read, with no route of its own, for the current state, a named state or a checkpoint.

module.name: Measures
module.responsibility: Lists every module of a reading with its interface counts, commit count and unjoined pairs, sorted by the count a reader chooses
module.description: One history read of a revision answers for every part at once, and a selection shares it. A row selects its module on the picture. An unread part states why, and no count joins a score.

module.name: Module interface
module.responsibility: Derives a module's interface from the relationships that reach it, with the counts that describe it
module.description: One derivation serves the reader, model inspect and a comparison. Nothing here is authored or stored.
